{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the revenue column for formatting
print("Unique revenue values (first 20):")
print(sales['revenue'].unique()[:20])

# Check if any revenue values contain commas (thousands separators)
has_commas = sales['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print(f"Number of revenue entries with commas: {has_commas.sum()}")

# Check if any values are like '1,234.56'
print("Sample values with commas:")
print(sales.loc[has_commas, 'revenue'].head())"}
